rubrics_metrics.guidance: Source artwork is PostScript/Illustrator with a proof PDF rendition. Deliver and maintain original Illustrator/PostScript source and include proof-level PDF export; retain XMP metadata where possible.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Artboard/page intended size is approximately 210.2556 x 134.4083 mm. Respect these dimensions when exporting print layouts or creating derivatives to ensure correct scaling and bleed handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of pages
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The template is a single-page/artboard asset; derivatives should preserve intended page/artboard count unless creating new approved versions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Printing plates / primary print colours
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary print plates for this asset are Black and Pantone 2935 C. Use these plates/inks for spot-colour prints or match the CMYK equivalents for process printing as specified in the palette.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approved colour palette (swatches with CMYK values)
rubrics_metrics.description: xmpTPg:SwatchGroups / xmpG:Colorants — explicit swatch names paired with CMYK components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overprint and transparency settings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Artwork uses visible overprint and no visible transparency. Preserve overprint settings when preparing print-ready files; flatten transparencies only as specified for the print workflow, ensuring overprint effects are maintained.

rubrics_metrics.name: Startup profile / intended workflow
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document was created with a 'Print' startup profile — the asset is configured for print production. Follow print production best-practices (bleeds, CMYK/spot colours, overprints) when using this template.
